title: Normalized action-site tensor model before comparison with a supplied adjoint
statement: Under the finite-field, prime, finite-type, quasi-compact and separated hypotheses of [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models], fix NativeClosedHomModels M, an ordinary CoefficientClosedStructure S on M.ordinaryHom, its symmetry beta, hmonoidal identifying its monoidal structure with the fixed ordinary one, and NativeOrdinaryTensorModels hS. There exist a closed symmetric monoidal model W with right adjoints exactly M.weilHom, its symmetry gamma, coefficient-unit identifications delta and epsilon, tensor comparison t for nativeForget, Hom comparison chi compatible with the fixed native and ordinary product-total Hom representatives, and TensorCoherence c for t. The unit c.unit equals nativeForget(delta), followed by the exact-forgetting single-functor comparison and epsilon inverse. The inverse of t at (A,K) is ordinary uncurrying of nativeForget applied to the unit of W.adjunction K, followed by chi. No arbitrary tensor bifunctor T or supplied adjunction or comparison is assumed or constrained.

source.place: Native constraint lifting steps 1 and 3; Stacks 06YS, 08J9 and 0FPT.

proof.text: Obtain m, gamma, delta, epsilon, t, a native tensor presentation, and c with the required unit formula from native_weil_tensor_geometry. This step supplies tensor geometry only, not native derived closedness.
Construct chi for precisely M.weilRepresentatives and M.ordinaryRepresentatives by native_hom_representative_exists. This is independent of m, t and all adjunctions.

Apply native_weil_representative_currying to the presentation. The natural derived bijections construct W by the existing generic closed_of_natural_currying. Its transpose equals the supplied bijection. The representative uncurrying formula gives NativeAdjunctionNormalization for W.

Apply native_weil_tensor_evaluation to W, its normalization and chi. Inverse transposition of f is tensor(f,identity) followed by evaluation. Naturality of t moves this tensor map through t; compose with t inverse, cancel t, and combine the two ordinary tensor maps. This proves the normalized uncurrying identity for every f. Apply it to the adjunction unit: its inverse transpose is identity, so the identity reduces to the displayed mate formula. Assemble W, gamma, delta, epsilon, t, chi, c and the three equations.

proof_origin.place: Tensor-geometry, prescribed Hom comparison, representative currying and evaluation compatibility; explicit adjunction-unit mate calculation in Lean.

theorem native_weil_ringed_tensor_model
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    (M : NativeClosedHomModels k₀ l X)
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure M.ordinaryHom)
    (β : @SymmetricCategory _ _ S.monoidal)
    (hmonoidal : S.monoidal = (inferInstance : MonoidalCategory
      (DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber))))
    (hS : NativeOrdinaryTensorModels l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber
      M.ordinaryHom M.ordinaryRepresentatives S β) :
    ∃ W : CoefficientClosedStructure M.weilHom,
    ∃ γ : @SymmetricCategory _ _ W.monoidal,
    ∃ δ : W.monoidal.tensorUnit ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (adicConstant k₀ l X),
    ∃ ε : S.monoidal.tensorUnit ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      (ProEtale.AdicSheaf.unit l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber),
    ∃ t : W.tensor ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
      (nativeForget k₀ l X).prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ S.tensor,
    ∃ χ : M.weilHom ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
      (nativeForget k₀ l X).op.prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ M.ordinaryHom,
    ∃ c : RingedForgetTensorTransposition.TensorCoherence W.monoidal S.monoidal
      γ β (nativeForget k₀ l X) t,
      c.unit = (nativeForget k₀ l X).mapIso δ ≪≫
        ((Functor.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor
          (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) 0).app
            (adicConstant k₀ l X)) ≪≫ ε.symm ∧
      NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X)
        (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
        M.weilHom M.ordinaryHom M.weilRepresentatives M.ordinaryRepresentatives
        (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) χ ∧
      (∀ A K, t.inv.app (A, K) =
        (S.transpose ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj A) ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj K)
          ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj (W.tensor.obj (A, K)))).symm
            ((nativeForget k₀ l X).map ((W.adjunction K).unit.app A) ≫
              χ.hom.app (op K, W.tensor.obj (A, K))))
